trophies.name: Star Fox Adventures Master
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.

trophies.name: Planet of Dinosaurs
trophies.description: Land on Dinosaur Planet and begin the hunt for General Scales.

trophies.name: Staff of Legend
trophies.description: Recover the magic Staff and learn to fight with it.

trophies.name: Test Subject
trophies.description: Pass your first Krazoa Test and claim a Krazoa Spirit.

trophies.name: A Boy and His Triceratops
trophies.description: Free Prince Tricky from the SharpClaw and gain a companion.

trophies.name: Downhill Racer
trophies.description: Win the SnowHorn's race down Ice Mountain.

trophies.name: Doctor's Visit
trophies.description: Cure Queen EarthWalker's illness.

trophies.name: Stone Cold
trophies.description: Recover your first SpellStone.

trophies.name: Hard to Swallow
trophies.description: Defeat Galdon and retrieve the SpellStone he swallowed.

trophies.name: Fortress Infiltrator
trophies.description: Escape CloudRunner Fortress with the SpellStone.

trophies.name: Eye See You
trophies.description: Defeat the RedEye King in the Walled City.

trophies.name: Set in Stone
trophies.description: Recover all four SpellStones and power the Force Point Temples.

trophies.name: Dragon Slayer
trophies.description: Defeat Drakor at Dragon Rock.

trophies.name: Face-Off
trophies.description: Confront General Scales at the Krazoa Palace.

trophies.name: Spirited Away
trophies.description: Return all six Krazoa Spirits to the Krazoa Palace.

trophies.name: Crystal Clear
trophies.description: Free Krystal from the Krazoa Palace.

trophies.name: Andross Undone
trophies.description: Defeat Andross in the skies above Dinosaur Planet.

trophies.name: Planet Restored
trophies.description: Complete Star Fox Adventures.

trophies.name: Trial by Battle
trophies.description: Pass the Test of Combat.

trophies.name: Nothing to Fear
trophies.description: Pass the Test of Fear.

trophies.name: Heavy Lifting
trophies.description: Pass the Test of Strength.

trophies.name: Know-It-All
trophies.description: Pass the Test of Knowledge.

trophies.name: Skill Check
trophies.description: Pass the Test of Skill.

trophies.name: Eyes Open
trophies.description: Pass the Test of Observation.

trophies.name: Back in the Cockpit
trophies.description: Complete an Arwing flight mission between planet areas.

trophies.name: Ace Pilot
trophies.description: Complete every Arwing flight mission.

trophies.name: Not a Scratch
trophies.description: Finish an Arwing mission without taking any damage.

trophies.name: Fetch
trophies.description: Use Tricky's Find command to uncover something buried.

trophies.name: Flame On
trophies.description: Use Tricky's Flame command to light a fire.

trophies.name: Good Boy
trophies.description: Use Tricky's Stay command to hold down a switch.

trophies.name: Best in Show
trophies.description: Teach Tricky every command.

trophies.name: Trial by Fire
trophies.description: Obtain the Fire Blaster upgrade for the Staff.

trophies.name: Blast Off
trophies.description: Obtain the Rocket Boost upgrade for the Staff.

trophies.name: Earthshaker
trophies.description: Obtain the Ground Quake upgrade for the Staff.

trophies.name: Fully Loaded
trophies.description: Collect every Staff upgrade.

trophies.name: Gold Rush
trophies.description: Find your first Gold Bar.

trophies.name: Bar None
trophies.description: Find all 50 Gold Bars and hand them to the WarpStone.

trophies.name: Whole Hearted
trophies.description: Extend your energy meter to its maximum.

trophies.name: Fairy Keeper
trophies.description: Obtain the Bafomdad Holder to carry spare lives.

trophies.name: Scarab Hoarder
trophies.description: Carry the maximum number of Scarabs at once.

trophies.name: Well Fed
trophies.description: Feed Tricky a GrubTub fungus.

trophies.name: Tribal Trials
trophies.description: Complete the LightFoot Village tests and earn the tribe's trust.

trophies.name: Behind the Scenes
trophies.description: Unlock the Making of Star Fox Adventures video.

trophies.name: DJ Fox
trophies.description: Unlock the game's Sound Test.

trophies.name: Sauria's Savior
trophies.description: Reach 100% completion.
